corrections.claim: A 50-turn plan runs when there is no edit
corrections.finding: TURNS_PLANNED=50 is used in the transcript sizing formula. PLAN_TURN_CAP=40 and PLAN_SEAT defaults to false in all three files.

corrections.claim: All three use a fallback model
corrections.finding: Fred defaults to a DeepSeek fallback. Harry and thrush default RELIEF_MODEL to an empty string; configuration could override this, but production configuration is not established from code.

corrections.claim: The transcript formula bounds per-turn cost
corrections.finding: It is a heuristic using cached-input pricing, a character floor and selective trimming. It excludes some serialized tool/schema content and cannot establish a strict uncached total-call bound.

corrections.claim: Stable rewritten tool IDs fix cache hits
corrections.finding: Quarry already stores each tool ID once and reuses it in subsequent messages. Deterministic new IDs alone do not prove a cache-hit improvement; provider routing, prefix mutation and retention also matter.

corrections.claim: Low cache hits explain everything about production cost
corrections.finding: Production cache data is not available in this review. Same-trace local repricing gives mean $0.018478 without cache versus actual $0.006700; the repriced mean still passes $0.03 G7.

corrections.claim: First-edit pressure guards against exactly error 1000
corrections.finding: It addresses one possible no-patch mechanism. Error 1000 also covers exceptions; no specific production root cause is established.

corrections.claim: Use no-cache cost in place of measured cost
corrections.finding: Keep attributable measured cost and clearly labeled uncached estimates separately. Add a miss-with-cache-write stress scenario if the provider charges writes; never present estimates as billing records.

corrections.claim: Upload v002 and save the result under v001
corrections.finding: Obsolete release context: v003 is the uploaded release and submissions/READY points to v003. Preserve its evidence; any candidate must be a new release.

recommended_order: Obtain production per-generation billing/token/cache metadata for the exact screening interval without enabling prompt/response content logging.
Address confirmed deadline and HTTP-402 classification behaviors with regression tests.
Measure and bound full request cost, including tools, output reservations, fallback pricing and retries; add progress-aware patch recovery.
Use actual-cost and uncached-cost reports on a broader independent task set with paired comparisons.
Freeze a new release only after evidence improves; do not reuse v002 or overwrite v003.
